description: This Java class 'Utils' contains various utility methods for integration testing, including HTTP request handling via RestAssured, random data generation, date formatting, and other helper functions specific to testing an Apache Fineract-based application.

classes.name: Utils
classes.description: A utility class for performing common operations in integration tests, like HTTP requests, data generation, date formatting, and JSON handling, tailored for testing the Fineract platform.

methods.name: performServerGet
methods.description: Send a GET request to the server and retrieve the response as a string or a specific JSON attribute.

methods.name: performServerPost
methods.description: Send a POST request with a JSON body and retrieve response data, optionally extracting a JSON attribute.

methods.name: randomStringGenerator
methods.description: Generate a random string with specified prefix and length from a given character set.

methods.name: uniqueRandomStringGenerator
methods.description: Generate a unique random string with a prefix and suffix length, avoiding duplicates within session.

methods.name: convertDateToURLFormat
methods.description: Convert a date string from 'dd MMMM yyyy' format to 'yyyy-MM-dd' format.

methods.name: getAuditDateTimeToCompare
methods.description: Get current audit datetime with handling for seconds precision, possibly sleeping to ensure consistency.

methods.name: convertJsonElementAsDate
methods.description: Convert a JSON array element to a Java Date object, handling date and optional time components.

methods.name: arrayDateToString
methods.description: Convert a list of integers representing a date to a hyphen-separated string.

methods.name: arrayDateTimeToString
methods.description: Convert a list of integers representing date and time components into a string with proper formatting.

methods.name: convertToJson
methods.description: Convert a Map or Object to its JSON string representation.

methods.name: getDateAsLocalDate
methods.description: Parse a date string into a LocalDate object using the specified formatter.

methods.name: getDifferenceInDays
methods.description: Calculate days between two LocalDate instances.

methods.name: getDifferenceInWeeks
methods.description: Calculate weeks between two LocalDate instances.

methods.name: getDifferenceInMonths
methods.description: Calculate months between two LocalDate instances.

methods.name: getDoubleValue
methods.description: Convert a BigDecimal amount to a double, scaling to 2 decimal places.
